description: This file contains utility functions for initializing and integrating the Preline UI component library within a React application. It exports an async function initPreline to dynamically load the Preline JavaScript bundle and initialize its DOM behaviors, and a React hook usePreline that calls initPreline on component mount or dependency updates.

methods.name: initPreline()
methods.description: Dynamically imports the 'preline' module and initializes its DOM behaviors by calling window.HSStaticMethods.autoInit() if available, or dispatching a DOMContentLoaded event as a fallback.

methods.name: usePreline(deps = [])
methods.description: A React hook that invokes initPreline after component mount or when dependencies change, enabling Preline components to initialize or re-initialize.
